outcome.summary: The exact candidate repairs explicit browser reader selection, makes Refresh establish a new cursor generation without waiting for RSC, and uses truthful body previews. A reached public-page keyboard assertion reproduces focus loss after recovery; the unchanged affected suite also has three story failures. Do not treat this review as closure of D3-001, AUD-005 or D4-016.

source.checkSnapshotMethod: A private shared clone, detached at the exact candidate head/tree, inside the authorized worker root. Its local main ref is pinned to the exact base. Dependencies, QA artifacts and browser harnesses stay in this clone or the worker .temp. Source tracked status is empty before and after checks. This avoids writing caches, environment files or dependency stamps into the read-only existing checkout.

readerAndSecurity: mainFeedApi chooses the explicit anonymous browser client for query.actingSubject absent; page, head and suggestions share that choice. An actor selects the authenticated client. Vote/follow/feedback/watermark commands retain the authenticated client and explicit actingSubject.

FeedProvider uses the production default mainFeedApi() construction. The optional supplied-client seam remains caller-controlled; the adapter specimens supply both clients. Specimens do not prove real session/Agent eligibility resolution.

SSR home reader selection, BFF bearer/cookie forwarding and Main's authenticated/actingSubject pairing were inspected as supporting code and are outside the 20-path patch. No Main authentication rule was relaxed.
400 invalid uses ordinary failure/retry copy; only moved/409 offers feed-changed restart. 401/403 and unavailable outcomes retain distinct handling.
generationsAndCancellation: FeedGeneration keys on the full query; a new initial response identity replaces the generation even at unchanged projection.sequence. Client Refresh calls api.page(query) directly and increments the child generation, so it does not wait for router.refresh/RSC completion.

Request counters reject obsolete restart responses; FeedPages active guards and polling stopped guards prevent old responses applying after replacement/unmount. Two browser DOM cases reached and passed their stale-content assertions.
Cancellation evidence concerns invalidation and suppression of stale UI writes. No HTTP AbortController transport cancellation is implemented or claimed.

The focused public-page run preserves /en?lang=en and recovers unique retained rows after exactly one injected successor 409. This is a controlled reproduction of the original conflict premise, not evidence of a naturally occurring conflict frequency.
previews: feedExcerpt removes recognized repeated headings and an Ingredients heading, retains meaningful same-title prose, and preserves chapter/release event excerpts. Card layout and line limits are unchanged.
Four candidate preview unit cases cover six recipe heading formats, empty/facts-only excerpts, meaningful same-title sentences including Chinese, and chapter/release excerpts.

Six unique retained Recipe excerpts were read from the shared Main using GET only. Their resulting preview is nonempty, comes verbatim from the original excerpt, and does not start with the duplicate title or Ingredients. One actual retained recipe row was viewed in the frontend at both widths; book/guide layout was viewed using existing authored stories.
assertionPreservation: The reviewer changed no candidate tests, story assertions, production source, static inventory or acceptance requirements.
Candidate g-1047 projection stories only add an explicit actingSubject to the existing query; their original interaction assertions remain.

Candidate error-state-copy replaces a pre-existing compound expression with separate moved/restart and invalid/server/retry assertions. This aligns the documented distinction; it is not reviewer-authored relaxation.
The static inventory change updates one context hash for the existing mainFeedApi read.data.items entry; it adds no new exemption.

findings.title: Keyboard Refresh removes the focused control and recovery leaves document.body active
findings.observation: The actual Refresh button is focused and activated with Enter. The error control disappears while Refreshing posts is visible; document.activeElement becomes BODY and stays BODY after a new successful cursor chain has rendered. The focused confirmation has 11 distinct retained rows, no remaining changed-feed alert and the same language URL. Its next Tab reaches the first retained author's link (AUDIT D2 A); do not infer that Tab went to global navigation.
findings.expected: A keyboard user who starts recovery retains an intentional focus destination while the control is replaced, and after completion focus is on the recovered list or a suitable actionable descendant.
findings.actual: BODY during the pending state and after completion.
findings.sourceCause: The restarting branch removes FeedFailure and its focused button. A completed restart remounts FeedPages with a new generation key; no focus handoff accompanies either replacement.
minimalReproduction: Start this exact candidate frontend with Task against the retained shared Main.

Open /en?lang=en in an anonymous browser. Intercept only the first /api/main/v1/feed request that contains cursor and return HTTP 409 {code:'cursor_conflict'}; pass every later request to the actual backend.
When the feed-changed alert appears, focus its Refresh button and press Enter once.
Wait for Refreshing posts to appear, then for at least six distinct [data-feed-item] rows and the alert to disappear.
Assert document.activeElement !== document.body. The assertion fails on the reviewed head, after URL, anonymous credentials, unique IDs and successful backend response assertions have passed.
findings.repairDirection: Preserve or transfer focus intentionally when recovery removes the control and when the new generation renders. Retain the fresh chain, busy status, URL/filter and reader-identity guarantees. Add this reached keyboard outcome to the owner's regression coverage.
findings.sourceOnlyRelatedSites: The initial-failure restart branch and New posts generation replacement also replace controls/subtrees. They are class-level source risks, not separately reproduced public failures in this review.

findings.title: Chinese public-fallback story aborts on two valid status elements before releasing recovery
findings.observation: canvas.getByRole('status') matches both the relationship-unavailable status and the refreshing status. The lookup throws before api.release(), so this original play function never reaches completion/fresh-chain assertions.
findings.assertionReached: The status lookup inside the intermediate loading expectation was reached; its ambiguous query failed.
minimalReproduction: Run the unchanged candidate feed.stories.tsx through goalctl test.
RecoverPublicFallbackChinese calls the shared recovery play; at line 743 getByRole('status') throws with 无法获取关系状态 and 正在刷新动态….
findings.repairDirection: Resolve the query premise to identify the refreshing status without dropping the loading-text, aria-busy, released-response, new-chain or completion assertions. This finding is about the story premise, not proof that public recovery remains stuck.

findings.title: EveryKind and Discussions require comment link names that differ from the rendered names
findings.observation: Exact role queries expect '41 comments' and '17 comments'; the rendered accessible names are '41 (41 comments)' and '17 (17 comments)'. Each role query throws before its visibility/href expectation can run.
findings.baselineEvidence: The same assertion lines and corresponding comment-label renderer are unchanged in the exact base/head diff. This establishes unchanged source premises only; the base runtime was not executed.
minimalReproduction: Run the unchanged candidate feed.stories.tsx through goalctl test.
EveryKind line137 cannot find a link named exactly 41 comments; Discussions line295 cannot find exactly 17 comments. Inspect the error role dump for the count-plus-localized labels.
findings.repairDirection: Return the accessible-name contract/premise to its owner, retaining the visibility and destination expectations. Do not silently weaken existing assertions or label this an independently reproduced regression introduced by the candidate.

No new Main authentication counterexample was reproduced. Optional custom mainFeedApi clients remain caller-controlled and do not substitute for testing actual signed-in persona selection.
